'''Brazzer''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who worked as a Guard in [[Diago Hixan]]'s Palace during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was present when the Palace was under attack by the Imperial forces led by [[Vaverone Zare]]. He was able to warn [[Tookreek]] and [[Voidhound]] about the situation before he was shot down by Imperial commandos.<ref name="TOR" />
